kebab_example: aliyun cassandra create-cluster --pay-type Subscription --period-unit Year --period 12 --auto-renew true --auto-renew-period 3 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --cluster-name apitest --data-center-name apitest --major-version 3.11 --instance-type cassandra.c.xlarge --node-count 3 --disk-type cloud_ssd --disk-size 160 --vpc-id vpc-bp1oxxxxxxxxxxgzv26cd --vswitch-id vsw-oqscxxxxxxxxxxxxx5e8c --password 'Alibaba0000!@#' --resource-group-id rg-xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCluster

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- Subscription: subscription.
- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

> Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型：

- Subscription：包年包月
- PayAsYouGo：按量付费

> 按量付费实例无到期时间
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration for the instance. Valid values:

- Year: year.
- Month: month.

> This parameter is required if PayType is set to Subscription
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：

- Year：包年；
- Month：包月。

> 若付费类型为Subscription则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. This parameter is required if PayType is set to Subscription. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.

> This parameter is not supported if PayType is set to PayAsYouGo
parameters.help_zh:
付费周期，PayType（付费类型）为Subscription时为必选参数，单位为月，可选值：1-9，12，24，36 。

> 付费类型为PayAsYouGo时不支持传入此参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- true: enables auto-renewal.
- false: does not enable auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，可选值：

- true（开启）
- false（不开启）

默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months. Valid values:

- 1
- 2
- 3
- 6
- 12

> This parameter is required if AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，可选值：

- 1
- 2
- 3
- 6
- 12

> 当AutoRenew为true时该参数必选
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available zone IDs. Use this parameter to specify the zone in which to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，可调用DescribeRegions查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster name.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character. The name can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
集群名称。

长度为2-128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字，‘.’，‘_’或‘-’
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the cluster. Examples of valid values:

- cassandra.c.large: 2 vCPUs, 4 GB memory.
- cassandra.c.xlarge: 4 vCPUs, 8 GB memory.
- cassandra.c.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs, 16 GB memory
parameters.help_zh:
集群实例类型。可取值部分示例：

- cassandra.c.large：2核 4G
- cassandra.c.xlarge：4核 8G
- cassandra.c.2xlarge：8核 16G
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the cloud disk. Examples of valid values:

- cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
- cloud_essd: Enterprise SSD (ESSD).
- cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
- local_ssd_pro: local SSD
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘存储类型。可取值示例：

- cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
- cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
- cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
- local_ssd_pro：本地SSD盘
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en: The storage size per node. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘存储大小。（每节点，单位：GB）
parameters.name: disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The password.

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=
parameters.help_zh:
密码。

格式要求：大写、小写、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度8-32位；特殊字符为!@#$%^&*()_+-=
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. If this parameter is not specified, the instance is added to the default resource group. You can view the resource group ID in the Resource Management console
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，不设置时落在默认资源组里，可在资源组控制台查看资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
